title: Polaris Key config catalog (.pkey/schema)
description: The schema document of a .pkey/ manifest: the product's config catalog — a schemaVersion plus one ConfigEntry per declarable key. Each entry's own `schema` field is a nested JSON-Schema fragment (the Draft-07 subset @polaris-key/catalog validates values against) — do not confuse the two layers. Mirrors validateCatalogShape in @polaris-key/manifest; the TypeScript validator is authoritative. The $id URL is an identifier, not a fetchable locator — this file ships inside the @polaris-key/manifest npm package.

schemaVersion.description: The catalog's shape version; bumped on incompatible changes and echoed in the signed config document.

key.description: Dotted identifier, unique within the catalog (e.g. run.concurrency).

kind.description: config = plaintext client setting · secret = redacted, delivered to the OS keyring · flag = an entitlement.

schema.description: A JSON-Schema fragment (the Draft-07 subset @polaris-key/catalog supports — unsupported keywords are rejected at publish time, never silently ignored) that values of this key must satisfy.

default.description: Schema-level default — the client's last-resort fallback.

managementDefault.description: CONFIG kinds only: the management state a freshly-minted key gets — default (overridable) · enforced (server wins) · hidden (enforced + withheld from enumeration).

delivery.description: SECRET kinds only: serverOnly (never leaves the worker) · clientScoped (delivered to the device keyring) · edgeMint (minted on demand at /<product>/config/mint/*).

userGrant.description: FLAG kinds: surfaced to the user as an included capability.

ui.description: Rendering hints only — never affect validation.

dependsOn.description: Presentation gating: show this entry only when another key equals a value.

accessor.description: Dotted path into the client's config object (config/secret kinds).

allOf.$comment: delivery is only valid for secret entries.
managementDefault is only valid for config entries.
